changelog:
Homelab 1.6.4 — First Release / 首个正式发布

Forked from an open-source Homelab client with the following additions.
本项目 fork 自开源 Homelab 客户端，在此基础上新增了以下功能：

New Features / 新增功能

- **New Home Dashboard** / **全新首页仪表盘**: system health (CPU / memory / disk temperature), Docker containers, and qBittorrent cards with 10-second auto-refresh — 系统健康（CPU/内存/磁盘温度）、Docker 容器、qBittorrent 卡片，10 秒自动刷新
- **CloudSaver Media Module** / **CloudSaver 影视模块**: poster search, one-tap transfer, auto-trigger plugins after watching, auto re-login on JWT expiry — 海报搜索、一键转存、看完即触发插件/运行、JWT 过期自动重登
- **OpenList player powered by VLCKit** / **OpenList 播放器升级为开源 VLCKit**: MKV/AVI and more formats, offline cache, Picture-in-Picture — 支持 MKV/AVI 等多格式、离线缓存与画中画
- **Arcane Interactive Terminal** / **Arcane 交互式终端** (open-source SwiftTerm): container images/statistics and logs — 容器镜像/统计、日志查看
- **Enhanced qBittorrent details** / **qBittorrent 详情增强**: Tracker and rate-limit management — Tracker 与限速管理
- **One-tap LAN vs. remote mode, bulk host replacement, external subtitles** / **一键切换局域网/远程模式、批量替换主机地址、外挂字幕**
- **Liquid Glass visual polish** / **Liquid Glass 视觉打磨** across OpenList, Arcane, qB, and CloudSaver

> Note / 注意: IPA signed with a free Apple ID (development profile, expires 2026-08-12). Refresh via SideStore/AltStore after expiry — IPA 使用免费 Apple ID 签名（development profile，2026-08-12 到期），到期后请通过 SideStore/AltStore 刷新。
